entities.summary: Reema Sathe is an Indian chemical engineer and activist. She created a snack company that shares its profits more fairly with small farmers. She involved 16,000 women and created "Manipur's first women-only farmer producer company". She was awarded the Nari Shakti Puraskar in 2017 for her work by the President of India and later noted for her work in 300 villages with 30,000 people by the International Livestock Research Institute in Nairobi.
